Round 2 tuning+correctness. MEASURED the cost curve (new scripts/costcurve.mjs -> progress/cost-curve.md): near the floor frame_ms ~ 20.8 + 838*MP on this SwiftShader box, so ~21ms is resolution-independent and no render scale can remove it. FIXED: (1) buildScene built the world BEFORE applyRung, so character-anatomy always used rung 15's LOD mix on every device - base scene 137,760 tris/69 dc -> 52,044/27, rung 0 now 48,340 tris/21 dc, inside the floor tier's 90k cap; (2) added the missing consumer of the EXPENSIVE rung queue - actors are rebuilt at the play boundary, never on the frame path; (3) rung 0 re-cut 0.50 -> 0.11 render scale and rung 2 0.60 -> 0.50 (it exceeded the floor tier's own 0.50 cap), chosen from real harness runs via new --rung-scale; (4) heap 'sawtooth' was Math.max(saw, peak-trough) conflating GC amplitude with total run excursion, plus boot garbage collected inside the measured window - perf.mjs now forces a GC at warmup end and reports amplitude and range separately: 24.84MB -> 0.61MB; the one 157-492ms longtask was that same boot GC and is now gone; (5) gpuProbe used gl.finish() which does not sync Chrome's command buffer - it reported ms:0 for all four points while burning 1.2s of boot, so classify() silently skipped the whole GPU branch; now uses readPixels; (6) scaler windows were frame-counted so descent was SLOWEST when the device was worst (30 frames = 3.5s at 116ms/frame) - added time-bounded early close and a multi-rung panic drop, both DOWN-only so 8:2 hysteresis is intact. PROVEN: pinned 30 at rung 0, 0 drops in 602 frames, 0 bad 3s windows, worst 33.5ms. simtest 66/66. Capture stills byte-identical (md5 20aa3a40 pre and post).

gap: Nothing pins with GL on: the SHIPPED config (--tier=auto --raster=auto -> floor, rung 0, 43x93 buffer, 30 Hz target) measured p50 49.9 / p95 66.7 / p99 100.0 / worst 133.4 ms with 57.75% dropped frames and 12 of 12 three-second windows dirty. The only clean pacing is loop-only (--raster=none), where p50/p95/p99 are 16.70/16.70/16.80 at 60 Hz and 33.30/33.40/33.50 at 30 Hz -- excellent body, but worst is 50-67 ms in EVERY run and 5-7 of ~15 three-second windows contain a drop, and it is not rendering. 4 of the 5 gate commands exit 1 (perf, budget skinned actors 14>6 floor / 14>10 low, touch worst 100.4ms + 1 stuck touch after pointercancel + TURBO 55.3mm out of reach, shoot.mjs --piece=typeface-lettering screenshot timeout at default accum=32 -- reproduced at HEAD in a clean worktree, so NOT a regression). Only simtest passes (66/66). Honesty is exemplary -- the cost curve retires the builder's own prior false claims and records the inert imposter column -- but perf.mjs and budget.mjs both tell the reader to see README ASSUMPTION A-D and README contains zero occurrences of ASSUMPTION.

Round 3 in flight. Whole-frame accounting landed in telemetry.js: every ms between two presents is now billed to pre / the nine spans / post / skip / postTask / idle, with the residual published (|wall - prevCb - gap|). New channels: wall, cb, gap, skip, postTask, idle, pre, post, skew, vsyncs. perf.mjs prints a TAIL ACCOUNTING table plus the worst 6 frames ranked BY INTERVAL and BY WALL separately, because Chromium snaps the rAF timestamp to the BeginFrame grid and a callback delivered 30 ms late still reports a clean 16.7 ms interval.

THE TAIL, NAMED. New whole-frame accounting in telemetry.js bills every ms between two presents to pre / the nine spans / post / skip / postTask / idle, and publishes the residual: |wall - prevCb - gap| mean 0.000 ms across every run. Verdict: the tail is NOT ours. SHIPPED (--tier=auto --raster=auto -> floor/rung0/30Hz): callback p50 7.8 / p95 13.5 / worst 22.6 ms against a 30 ms wall, while gap is p50 27.4 / p95 54.3 and idle p50 23.9 / p95 51.1; all six worst frames show prevCb 6-19 ms, vsyncs=2 (pacer took exactly its divisor), zero longtask, and 60-90 ms of wall with the main thread running nothing of ours. SwiftShader raster is off the main thread and gates the next BeginFrame. LOOP-ONLY floor@30 (the floor tier's own boot rate), uncontended 45 s: p50 33.30 p95 33.40 p99 33.40 WORST 50.00, 1 drop in 1344 (0.07%), 1 of 14 windows dirty; that single frame is gap 54.4 / idle 54.2 / prevCb 0.7 / vsyncs 2 / longtask 0. Candidates ELIMINATED by measurement, not argument: skip=0.00 at every percentile (the pacer's declined callbacks are free); pre/post p50 0.00 p95 0.10 (the loop scaffolding and the telemetry are not the hitch); GC amplitude 0.70MB and 0 longtasks; PROGRAMS delta 0. Also found: Chromium SNAPS the rAF timestamp to the BeginFrame grid, so a callback delivered 42 ms late still reports a clean 16.7 ms interval — the report now ranks the tail by interval AND by wall and prints skew. FIXES: (1) touch stuck-pointer was a HARNESS bug - touchCancel was dispatched with a non-empty touchPoints list, which means 'nothing changed', so 60 cancel cycles delivered 1 DOM event total; new scripts/touchprobe.mjs proved it from the raw DOM stream. Fixed, plus 3 latent runtime bugs it had never exercised (lostpointercapture double-cancel, retirement iterating a 256-entry window, DOWN-after-UP in one drain), each with a regression case. Touch robustness now 0 active / 0 stuck on all three storms. (2) REACH: the layout was fractions of each axis, so it failed by aspect ratio - TURBO 44.4mm portrait, 55.3mm landscape against a 40mm cap. Relaid out anchored in CSS px to the thumb pivots; now STICK 27.9 / TURBO 34.8 / ACTION_B 31.1 / ACTION_A 18.2 mm, and identical in landscape. Artwork and hit rects now come from ONE table (they used to disagree - turbo was drawn where nothing was hittable). (3) input span p95 0.90-1.50 -> 0.10-0.20 at 60 Hz by arming the per-frame navigator.getGamepads() poll behind gamepadconnected. (4) perf_synthetic NEVER POPULATED: the world was built at the default rung 8 before the tier's rung was known, so headroom under floor's caps computed as zero; now 60 of 60 draw calls and 89,988 of 90,000 tris, AT CAP, and budget.mjs passes on it. (5) shoot.mjs --piece=typeface-lettering: THREE bugs - waitUntil:'load' waited on a synchronous 80 s capture with a 120 s navigation budget, page.waitForFunction(pred,{timeout}) passed the options as the page-function ARGUMENT so the readiness gate silently used Playwright's 30 s default (same bug in 6 other scripts), and a hardcoded 120 s screenshot timeout. Now 6/6 captures with no flags. (6) overlay pre-warm at boot killed a 50.8 ms lazy-Canvas2D hitch (overlay worst 50.8 -> 5.7 ms). PROVEN UNCHANGED: simtest 66/66; four truck captures across the whole change set, two before and two after, all md5 5e91a2662a19fd65158d27c5c15623b4; lint-determinism clean; budget.mjs PASS on all four tiers. STILL FAILING: overlay p95 2.20 vs 1.80 at a FORCED 60 Hz on the floor tier (the tier boots at 30 Hz, where it is 2.70 vs 4.15 PASS - the report now names that pairing as diagnostic); input p95 0.60 vs 0.46 at 30 Hz, where a --no-input run reads worst 1.40 ms with ZERO events, i.e. the budget is below this instrument's 100us resolution; and the interval tail itself, which is unattributable to this loop on this hardware.
